rows.name_as_written: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints consortium
rows.quote: Findings were replicated using GWAS data from the Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints consortium.
rows.dataset_named_in_source: Gene-Lifestyle Interactions in Dental Endpoints consortium
rows.coder_note: Abstract names the GLIDE consortium periodontitis GWAS as replication data; no dictionary row is for it.

rows.quote: Using summary statistics from a large‐scale protein quantitative trait loci (pQTL) study of 4719 circulating proteins in Icelandic individuals (Ferkingstad et al. 2021) and GWAS data for periodontitis from the Veterans Affairs Million Veteran Program (VA‐MVP), we aimed to gain genetic insights into protein targets involved in the pathogenesis of periodontitis.
rows.coder_note: Sentence names the periodontitis GWAS from the Million Veteran Program; no dictionary row is that dataset.
